title: Physiology-informed deep learning detects sepsis cardiomyopathy on echocardiography
summary: A deep learning model combining EchoJEPA visual representations, phase-aware modeling, left-ventricular area features and multi-cycle aggregation classified sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy from apical four-chamber echo cine loops. In 530 development patients (305 with the condition) cross-validated AUROC was 0.933 (0.910-0.954); in an external MIMIC-IV-ECHO cohort of 93 patients (39 cases) it was 0.929 (0.864-0.980) versus 0.735 for direct EchoJEPA. The study is retrospective, with a small external cohort and a troponin-based label that differs from the development definition.
